summary: BitVec::insert rejected index == len because assert_in_bounds requires index < len. The fix checks index.saturating_sub(1), allowing insertion at the end of a nonempty vector. The commit updates the existing doctest at src/vec/api.rs:613 to insert at index 5 into a five-bit vector, which detects this bug. However, prototype/mine.py supports library and integration tests only, not doctests. The existing vec::tests::misc unit test inserts within bounds and does not detect this regression. The test field is empty because the detecting doctest cannot be selected by the current runner. No tests were executed.
